evidence: Perfect size for brown bagging.  It may be small, but you still get big chunks of tuna, not that mushy stuff sold in grocery stores.

evidence: Finally, good Tuna made only better by the Olive Oil - no more water packed for me...

It does not specify extra virgin olive oil and I noticed that the oil was quite light in color, but - trusting that it is actually olive oil and not canola sneaked in dishonestly - the flavor was very good.
To me, tuna packed in olive oil is far superior to tuna packed in water.
If you like tuna in oil, you will enjoy this product. Excellent taste, appearance and texture. Keep in mind that not all 'tuna in oil' is in olive oil - this one is.
assertions.comment: Multiple reviews explicitly state that the tuna is packed in olive oil, confirming the assertion.

evidence: Love the bold taste...like having good strong coffee at Starbucks but paying far less making it at home.
Very good taste.
Flavor is smooth without bitter after taste.
